item.name: Room 1
item.mainRisk: Bed Monster under the bed; wrong treatment kills the patient; incomplete care leaves them at risk
item.whatYouDo: Put the patient on the bed, run DNA analysis, give the matching hallway treatment, and leave once recovery starts.
item.cardSummary: Standard care bed in the medical wing. Room 1 works like the other medical-wing rooms: diagnose, treat, and watch the bed for grabs.

item.name: Room 6 (X-Ray)
item.mainRisk: Wrong sequences stall care; wrong final treatments still kill the patient
item.whatYouDo: Watch a short color sequence (commonly four colors) flash, then repeat it exactly. A wrong order regenerates a new sequence. After the scan, finish normal treatment items.
item.cardSummary: The first skill room. Memory is the core job: copy the sequence, clear the X-Ray step, then finish treatment.

item.name: Room 7 (Heart Monitor)
item.mainRisk: Bed Monster can still appear; skull clicks slow the meter
item.whatYouDo: Click white progress targets to push the heart monitor toward 100 percent while avoiding red skulls that lower progress. Skulls slow you down but do not kill the patient.
item.cardSummary: A speed-and-accuracy room. Race the meter up while dodging skulls that punish sloppy clicking.

item.name: Room 8 (Surgery)
item.minigame: Timed item fetch after IV start
item.mainRisk: Tendril emergency can spawn during recovery; tasing or shooting the Tendril kills the patient
item.whatYouDo: Start with IV Drops to begin a roughly 45-second surgery clock, then deliver requested tools such as scalpel, scissors, organ, transplant, or antibiotics before the timer ends.
item.cardSummary: The hardest bed in the hospital. Surgery timers are strict, and the Room 8 Tendril must be cleared with the mini-game only.
